name: 45106-screenshotprefill-qwen3vl2b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, ~2B params, ungated: a 24-layer ViT over a 28-layer language model. Full shapes are in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=500, bound at 500 requests, no warmup and no cooldown. streams equals the request count on purpose: the whole set is submitted at once, so the engine is saturated from the first instant.
workload: single-turn image+text chat: one mobile-app screenshot per request plus a one-line instruction, output capped at 32 tokens. The fixture is the first 500 rows of the `screen2words(cauldron)` config of `lmms-lab/LLaVA-OneVision-Data` (ungated), materialised to `data/screen2words-500/` as a two-column parquet (`prompt`, `image`) because the hub rows carry the text in a `conversations` list-of-dicts; 400 are 1080x1920 and 100 are 540x960, ~1734 merged vision tokens per image. The dataset is part of the declaration and may not be replaced with synthetic images.
purpose: A mobile screenshot captioning service answering one-line questions about app images, 500 requests at once on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine command line. Anything not listed is left at the engine default.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 8192
